title: CraftBlocker
description: CraftBlocker is a simple, high-performance plugin that allows server administrators to easily block the crafting of specific items through a simple configuration file.
body:
CraftBlocker is a lightweight and straightforward Minecraft server plugin designed to give administrators full control over what items players can and cannot craft. Whether you want to disable overpowered items, restrict specific gear for custom game modes, or prevent game-breaking exploits, CraftBlocker lets you enforce these rules seamlessly without affecting server performance.

/craftblocker reload - Reloads the plugin configuration and applies changes instantly
